nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Integrated Gujarat health assurance arrangement combining PM-JAY with Mukhyamantri Amrutam for eligible beneficiaries.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on the applicable Gujarat beneficiary category and PM-JAY/MA rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Gujarat PMJAY-MA.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
